title: Sign Up, Sign In, Stay Private
audience: Prepaid, Cash App, and Chime users who need a private, secure account for their own money
objectives: Understand how sign-up creates your secure private account
Learn how sign-in verifies your identity and protects access
Explain row-level privacy where each person sees only their own cards, money, and history

analogy.title: An Apartment Building with Locked Doors
analogy.text: Think of the app like an apartment building. Everyone uses the same front entrance, but each person gets their own apartment with a unique key. Your cards, balance, and transaction history live inside your locked unit — not in the hallway. Even though neighbors are in the same building, they cannot open your door or see your belongings. Row-level privacy is that lock on every single row of data, making sure you only see your own stuff, every time you sign in. It works automatically in the background every time.

pitch30Seconds: Signing up creates your private account with a secure login only you control. Signing in proves it's really you, like unlocking your front door with your key. Once inside, row-level security makes sure you see only your cards, your money, and your history — never anyone else's. No peeking, no mixing. This keeps your information safe and builds trust, because even though we all use the same app, your data stays completely private to you.
keyPoints: Sign-up creates your secure private login so only you can access your money
Sign-in verifies your identity each time to unlock just your account
Row-level privacy means you see only your own cards, money, and history — no one else's
Privacy builds trust because your data stays separate, safe, and never mixed with other users

recallQuiz.question: What does sign-up create?
options: A shared public account for everyone
A temporary guest pass with no privacy
recallQuiz.explanation: Sign-up creates your own private, secure account that only you can access with your login.

recallQuiz.question: What does sign-in do?
options: Verifies your identity to unlock your private data
Shares your cards with other users
Creates a new account every time you log in
recallQuiz.explanation: Sign-in proves it is really you so you can safely access your own cards, money, and history.

recallQuiz.question: What does row-level privacy guarantee?
options: You only see your own cards, money, and history
Everyone can see everyone else's data
Your data is visible to neighbors in the app
recallQuiz.explanation: Row-level privacy ensures each person sees only their own cards, money, and history, keeping all data private.

testModeNote: Even in test mode, authentication still protects demo data and no real money moves.
